name: EASM period ingest
description: Converts one reporting period of EASM deliverables (asset inventory xls/xlsx + report docx) or a ready data pack into the portal's SQLite snapshot as a draft, computes aggregates and period-over-period diff.
descriptionCn: 把一期 EASM 交付物（资产清单 xls/xlsx + 报告 docx）或现成的数据包转换并写入门户的 SQLite 快照（草稿），计算聚合与期次差异。
author: ThreatBook

reasons: writes ~/.flocks/data/easm.db and copies evidence screenshots into the Data Leaks page assets
